item.title: Refresh planned for Northern Quarter adult shops
item.description: The former Big in Amsterdam and Love Boutique outlets on Manchester's Tib Street are to be pulled down and replaced with a three-and-a-half-storey building featuring retail and leisure space, under plans lodged with the city council. The post Refresh planned for Northern Quarter adult shops appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Stockport retail warehouse primed for sale
item.description: B&M and Dreams occupy the two-unit 18,500 sq ft Great Portwood Street building, which is available for just shy of £3.2m. The post Stockport retail warehouse primed for sale appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Reds reveal academy overhaul plans
item.description: Proposals to upgrade Liverpool FC’s youth development facility have been lodged, with architect KSS on board for design work. The post Reds reveal academy overhaul plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester construction starts drop for second year running as headwinds bite
item.description: Just 17 schemes broke ground in Manchester and Salford in 2025, down from a record low of 20 the year before. However, pipelines across all sectors remain chunky, according to Deloitte’s annual crane survey. The post Manchester construction starts drop for second year running as headwinds bite appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Developer behind Beales revamp in Kendal goes bust
item.description: Heart of Cumberland has entered receivership, leaving the future of the 40,200 sq ft former department store in limbo. The post Developer behind Beales revamp in Kendal goes bust appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Domis reports 56% turnover increase
item.description: With a £496m project pipeline, the Wigan-based contractor was optimistic about the future in its annual report for the year ending 30 April 2025. The post Domis reports 56% turnover increase appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Cement producers’ pipeline plans take shape
item.description: A consultation process is live for Peak Cluster, a project led by four cement and lime companies aiming to capture the carbon dioxide they generate and store it permanently under the Irish Sea. The post Cement producers’ pipeline plans take shape appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Salford becomes latest city to head to MIPIM
item.description: The local authority has extended its long-running programme of activity with Place North, including heading to the global expo with the North of England delegation next month. The post Salford becomes latest city to head to MIPIM appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Gwynedd approves Williams’ 48 Bangor homes
item.description: Social housing provider Adra is on board as partner on the fully affordable development, which sailed through committee with 12 votes in favour. The post Gwynedd approves Williams’ 48 Bangor homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Northern Group tables 200-home Secret Lake proposal
item.description: Plans for hundreds of homes on a 12-acre site that lies partly in Stockport and partly in Manchester have been lodged with both councils. The post Northern Group tables 200-home Secret Lake proposal appeared first on Place North West.
